---
title: Handouts and slides
subtitle: 'Printable, editable, and accessible materials'
description: >-
  Every worksheet, chart, template, and slide deck of the course, with its
  web version, its printable PDF, its editable source, and its license.
---

Each handout has these forms:

- an accessible **web page**, which works with a screen reader and on a phone,
- a **PDF** for print in A4, tagged for screen readers (PDF/UA-1),
- a **Word file** for each worksheet that you fill in, so that you can type your answers on a laptop,
- an **editable source**: the Quarto file in the repository folder `contents/handouts/`, and the SVG diagrams or the Markdown file below.

All exercises work on paper or in a Word file on a laptop. No exercise needs an online whiteboard or an account.

## Slide decks {#slide-decks}

The decks are Reveal.js presentations. Use the arrow keys to move. Press `S` for the presenter notes, `F` for full screen, and `?` for all keyboard shortcuts. The decks contain no dates or venues, so they serve every edition.

| Deck                                                                    | Topic                                                    | License      |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| [Orientation](slides/00-intro.qmd)                                      | The question of the day, four lenses, research-use cards | CC BY 4.0    |
| [Lens 1: Scale and environment](slides/01-scale.qmd)                    | Footprint and provenance, the BLOOM case                 | CC BY 4.0    |
| [Lens 2: Representation and Displacement](slides/02-representation.qmd) | Datasets and stereotypes, the LAION-5B case              | CC BY 4.0    |
| [Lens 3: Lifecycle and labor](slides/03-lifecycle-labor.qmd)            | Hidden labor, the Kenyan labeling case                   | CC BY 4.0    |
| [Lens 4: Political economy](slides/04-political-economy.qmd)            | Power, "open" claims, the EU AI Act                      | CC BY 4.0    |
| [Panarchy and Ecocycle](slides/05-panarchy.qmd)                         | The afternoon session                                    | CC BY-SA 4.0 |

: Slide decks {.striped}

The decks are available as HTML only. PDF versions follow after a check of their legibility and accessibility.
